identity.renderer: ANGLE (AMD, AMD Radeon Graphics (radeonsi renoir ACO), OpenGL ES 3.2 Mesa 26.2.2-arch1.1)

solver.method: MLS-MPM / APIC, experimental cohesive Hencky plasticity

limitations: 12 m development terrain; planned 40 m map and deeper ground are unfinished.
Sleeping boundary chunks act as fixed support until awakened; sparse execution still uses dense grid storage.
Restricted four-axis fixture; full machine joints and chassis are not implemented.
Soil contact is coupled once per frame batch; this is a coupling prototype, not calibrated hydraulics.
No explicit pore water, drainage, or engineering calibration.
Fixed-point grid accumulation introduces quantization.
CPU diagnostic readback is included in wall-time measurements.
Solver buffer allocation excludes renderer and driver memory.
